column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying each test session record.
A TIMESTAMP(6) capturing the exact date/time when the session was recorded.
An enum (DevScope_enum) indicating the tested device category (e.g., Keyboard, Headset, Gamepad, Mouse, Controller).
A NUMERIC(5,2) showing CPU usage percentage during the test session.
An INTEGER specifying memory usage in megabytes at the time of the test.
An enum (DriverStability_enum) describing driver stability status (Stable, Beta, or Experimental).
A SMALLINT indicating how many seconds/minutes it takes to complete a firmware update.
A NUMERIC(5,2) representing wireless signal strength (e.g., in dBm or relative scale).
A SMALLINT showing current battery percentage (0–100).
An INTEGER specifying battery capacity in milliamp-hours (mAh).
A NUMERIC(4,1) for the device’s remaining or estimated battery life in hours.
A NUMERIC(5,2) indicating the number of minutes required for a full battery charge.
A BOOLEAN (true/false) stating whether quick charge is supported by the device.
A VARCHAR(25) field describing the USB power delivery or specification (e.g., 7.5W, 5W, 10W).
A NUMERIC(5,2) measuring overall latency in milliseconds from user input to system response.
A NUMERIC(5,2) capturing input lag (in ms) between the device and the system.
A SMALLINT describing the device's polling rate in Hertz (times per second).
A NUMERIC(4,2) specifying the debounce time (in ms) for mechanical or electrical inputs.
A NUMERIC(4,2) indicating the device’s response time (in ms) after input is detected.
A NUMERIC(4,3) measuring how many milliseconds it takes for a click/button press to register.
